Small store vs independent inventory and billing teams.
Monolith one deployable app · Microservices catalog, order, payment · Simple local calls Distributed communication + · operations
Read the diagram: Choose based on team size, boundaries and scaling needs; not hype.

Monolith: OrderService -> local InventoryService
Microservices: Order API -> Inventory API or event
Expected result: Remote calls require timeouts, monitoring and failure handling.

Interview question: Should every small app use microservices?
Answer: No. A modular monolith can be simpler and appropriate.
Remember: One unit vs independent services.
